summary: Full end-to-end validation of the 6 admin/UX batch features. Backend: 10/10 pytest (test_iteration20_admin_batch.py) — admin_stats.revenue matches sum of only-Livrée orders (4350 DA), DELETE /orders/{id} removes order + linked gift_cards and updates revenue, invalid id => 404, /admin/analytics returns all keys for period=day|week|month|all and requires admin, PUT /settings persists chat_quick_replies, app_download_enabled, app_store_url, play_store_url, theme_mode=manual + theme_manual in {rose,mauve,gold,noir}. Frontend (preview URL, admin + client): Statistiques tab renders with 4 stat cards, 4 period buttons, top-products & top-customers tables (data-testid ok). Commandes tab shows 15 red 'Supprimer' buttons (admin-order-delete-*). Chat tab: selecting a conversation reveals chat-quick-replies with 2 default buttons. Settings tab: theme-manual <select> options include rose/mauve/gold/noir, set-app-enabled/set-app-store/set-play-store/quick-reply-add all present. After save, footer on home shows footer-app-download with correct App Store / Play Store hrefs, and <html> gets class 'theme-noir'. On /compte after client login, profile-tier-badge shows 'Statut BRONZE'.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx now >1600 lines — should be split (AnalyticsPanel, ChatAdminPanel, SettingsPanel already inline). Extracting them into /pages/admin/*.jsx would greatly improve readability/testability.
delete_order does not require CSRF or a soft-delete audit trail; consider soft-delete (deleted_at) so that historical revenue can still be recomputed for period analytics if needed.
admin_analytics iterates orders in Python for aggregation — fine for small volumes but should be replaced with a MongoDB aggregation pipeline once #orders > a few thousand.
